meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 让 Claude 带你从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2:先检测旧安装,读取并汇总身份、渠道、定时任务等配置,再分阶段和你确认后写入新系统,期间会记录迁移状态文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”等关键词,或要求从 OpenClaw 导入时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2,开始吧
say.note: 触发迁移流程,先做发现。

say.text: 从 OpenClaw 导入我的渠道和定时任务
say.note: 逐项确认后写入新系统。

say.text: 迁移我的身份和记忆,用共享方式
say.note: 按提示选择共享或分离。

howto.what_en: Helps you migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2: detects an existing install, summarizes its config, then walks you through each migration step and applies changes after confirmation, tracking progress in a state file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw", or ask to import from OpenClaw.

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2, let's start.
say_en.note: Starts the migration flow with discovery.

say_en.text: Import my channels and scheduled tasks from OpenClaw.
say_en.note: Walks you through each migration area.

say_en.text: Migrate my identity and memory, shared style.
say_en.note: Prompts you to choose shared or separate.
